httpx: httpx: the package the request functions are imported from
request: httpx: httpx.request, which takes the method as its first argument
method: httpx: the keyword httpx.request takes the method under
url: httpx: the keyword every request function takes the URL under
Client: httpx: the constructor for a client, whose instances take the same calls
AsyncClient: httpx: the constructor for an async client, whose instances take the same calls
clientCall: suss: PyClientCall variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-python
status_code: httpx: Response.status_code, the status the server sent
is_success: httpx: Response.is_success, true for a status in 200 to 299
json: httpx: Response.json, the body parsed as JSON
text: httpx: Response.text, the body as a string
content: httpx: Response.content, the body as bytes
